item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 15/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. A cold front is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong on Saturday. Temperatures will fall appreciably over the region. Under the influence of an intense winter monsoon and upper-air disturbance, it will remain cold with some rain over southern China during the weekend to midweek next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 16 - 19 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
